critical_code_review_comments: PlanTakeoff.jsx line 1270 references TOOLS.CALIBRATE while the toolbar and click handler use TOOLS.CALIB. In practice this only affects the setTool(...) fallback when analyze is invoked without calibration; low priority but should be aligned to TOOLS.CALIB.
PlanTakeoff.jsx is 4629 lines — file exceeds the 700-line guideline and should be split into smaller focused modules (canvas tools, calibration, analyze/estimation pipeline, dialogs, side panels).
